scope: 30 additional contextual body figures across eight pages; General Conference opening image excluded from qualifying body count. Existing text/cards preserved.

placements.title: Begin with the purpose of worship
placements.description: A contemporary study illustration. Read the dedicatory prayer and consider its requests for learning, holiness and help.
placements.alt: Two friends reading an open scripture book on a shaded garden terrace
placements.approvalBasis: Existing approved topic artwork; Salt Lake Temple full-size original visually inspected for this placement. Captions and rendered placement require independent review.

placements.title: Carry a covenant into daily care
placements.description: A contemporary illustration of neighbors offering practical help. Consider one way to live the willingness to bear burdens described in the passage.
placements.alt: Two neighbors clearing fallen branches from an older neighbor's garden path
placements.approvalBasis: Existing approved topic artwork; Salt Lake Temple full-size original visually inspected for this placement. Captions and rendered placement require independent review.

placements.title: Temple building across generations
placements.description: A historical illustration of skilled building work, not a reconstruction of a particular temple. It invites reflection on the patient work of preparing places of worship.
placements.alt: Two stonemasons measuring a carved building stone, a historical interpretation
placements.approvalBasis: Existing approved topic artwork; Salt Lake Temple full-size original visually inspected for this placement. Captions and rendered placement require independent review.

placements.title: Keep the account open
placements.description: A contemporary illustration of examining an account. The pictured document is not an original Church record. Read Joseph Smith's account itself and keep its words distinct from interpretation.
placements.alt: A reader examining an illustrative document beside an open book in an archive
placements.approvalBasis: Existing approved topic artwork; Salt Lake Temple full-size original visually inspected for this placement. Captions and rendered placement require independent review.

placements.title: Follow the shared work through the text
placements.description: A contemporary study illustration. Compare the passage with the question you are investigating instead of relying on a remembered quotation.
placements.alt: Two readers comparing a passage with their notes
placements.approvalBasis: Existing approved topic artwork; Salt Lake Temple full-size original visually inspected for this placement. Captions and rendered placement require independent review.

placements.title: Approach an inquiry prayerfully
placements.description: A contemporary illustration of seeking God while studying. It does not depict Joseph Smith or the events of his account.
placements.alt: A man pausing in prayer beside a closed book in a quiet park
placements.approvalBasis: Existing approved topic artwork; Salt Lake Temple full-size original visually inspected for this placement. Captions and rendered placement require independent review.

placements.title: Give each person room to speak
placements.description: A contemporary illustration of listening after loss. Family members may express grief differently; patient attention can make room for what each person needs to say.
placements.alt: Two women making room for a quiet conversation in a garden
placements.approvalBasis: Existing approved topic artwork; Salt Lake Temple full-size original visually inspected for this placement. Captions and rendered placement require independent review.

placements.title: Help with the ordinary burdens
placements.description: A contemporary illustration of practical care. Ask which errand or ordinary task would help, and let the family guide your offer.
placements.alt: A neighbor helping a parent load groceries into a parked car
placements.approvalBasis: Existing approved topic artwork; Salt Lake Temple full-size original visually inspected for this placement. Captions and rendered placement require independent review.

placements.title: Return to resurrection hope when ready
placements.description: An illustrative empty tomb, not an identified historical site. It accompanies the study of resurrection through Christ and offers no explanation for a particular child’s death.
placements.alt: An illustrative empty rock-cut tomb beyond wildflowers in morning light
placements.approvalBasis: Existing approved topic artwork; Salt Lake Temple full-size original visually inspected for this placement. Captions and rendered placement require independent review.

placements.title: Rebuild with patient companionship

placements.alt: Two adults walking together outdoors, one using a cane
placements.approvalBasis: Existing approved topic artwork; Salt Lake Temple full-size original visually inspected for this placement. Captions and rendered placement require independent review.

placements.title: Start by listening to the circumstances

placements.approvalBasis: Existing approved topic artwork; Salt Lake Temple full-size original visually inspected for this placement. Captions and rendered placement require independent review.

placements.approvalBasis: Existing approved topic artwork; Salt Lake Temple full-size original visually inspected for this placement. Captions and rendered placement require independent review.

placements.title: Bring your study into prayer
placements.description: A contemporary illustration of prayer after study. After reading the message, you might name one gratitude, need, or question as a personal response.
placements.alt: A woman pausing in prayer after study at her dining table
placements.approvalBasis: Existing approved Christ-praying artwork; full official Prayers for Peace message read 2026-09-08, including consistent prayer in joyful and distressed times. Caption application is explicitly personal.
placements.sourceRead: Official full message paragraphs corresponding to lines82–98 support sincere prayer without flowery wording and continued prayer rather than only in crisis. No direct quotation.
